sanskrit: ācāryyaḥ sādhako vāpi putrakaḥ samayī tathā ||
sa vāhyā bhyantaraṃṇaiva sa raso? dhyāna niṣṭhatā ||
tatsamīpe svayanneva nindāṃ kuryyānna? tasya vai ||
daulyaṃ dāryaṃ tathā bhrāṃnti lokayātrāñca varjjayet ||
na nindyāt kāraṇe devaṃ na ca vākyaṃ tadudbhavam ||
ṛtu mṛtyā ca yat spṛṣṭaṃ pakvamanvādi varjjayet ||
śaṅkaro nārccito yāvat tāvat karmma na kārayet ||
evaṃ bhavati śuddhistu gurorddha yatra nādibhiḥ ||
iti prakare pārameśvare mahātantre sāmānyaprakaraṇeśrotvātra paṭalaḥ ||
aṇḍajaṃ voṇḍajaṃ vasthaṃ yatkarmaṇe mataṃ tathā ||
ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi madhu tailaṃ lavaṇameya ca ||
iti puṣkare pārameśvare mahātantre sāmānyapuraṇe prāyaścittapaṭalaḥ || 3 ||
śmaśānaṃ ki smṛtaṃ deva agnihotra gṛhaṃ ca kiṃ ||
tathā cā ṛṣabhaṃ caiva dhenumaṇḍalameva ca ||
aṣṭau dikṣa sthitā brahman strisro maṇḍalamadhyamāḥ ||
īśānena ghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ gāyatryā tu kuśodakaṃ ||
oṃ jagadyoni svāhā || vaiṣṇavī uttarasyāṃ || oṃ amoghamātre svāhā ||
vṛṣabhastayormadhye || oṃ jagadhṛdaye svāhā aindrī prācyāṃ || oṃ

svāhā || aiśānī aiśānyāṃ || oṃ sarvatejasaṃhāriṇi sarvāmṛtasaṃhāriṇi
svāhā || raudrī vṛṣabhasthā sravaḥ || oṃ śrava śrava gala gala dulu dulu

śivānto na hi yuṣmādi dvitīyo muktidaḥ śivaḥ ||
oṃ vyomavyāpine namaḥ || mahāśivaḥ || oṃ bhavabhave namaḥ || sṛṣṭiśivaḥ

saṃhāraśivaḥ || oṃ sarvabhūtasukhaprade namaḥ || anugrahaśivaḥ || oṃ namaḥ

oṃ aghorebhyo namaḥ || maṇḍalamadhye || oṃ aghorebhyo namaḥ || prācyāṃ ||

svāhā || raudrī vṛṣabhasthā sravaḥ || oṃ śrava śrava gala gala dulu dulu
amṛtaṃ bhavatu svāhā || sarvāsāṃ vatsakāḥ || iti dhenumaṇḍalamantrakośaḥ
eka eva sthito madhye vyomavyāpī mahāśivaḥ ||
śivānto na hi yuṣmādi dvitīyo muktidaḥ śivaḥ ||
oṃ vyomavyāpine namaḥ || mahāśivaḥ || oṃ bhavabhave namaḥ || sṛṣṭiśivaḥ
|| oṃ  bhavodbhave namaḥ || sthitiśivaḥ || oṃ muñca muñca namaḥ ||
saṃhāraśivaḥ || oṃ sarvabhūtasukhaprade namaḥ || anugrahaśivaḥ || oṃ namaḥ
śivāyaḥ || oṃ namo namaḥ śivāya namo namaḥ || muktiśivaḥ || oṃ
prathamanamaḥ || tirobhāvaśivaḥ || oṃ sarvasarvade namaḥ || bhūtidaḥ śivaḥ ||
oṃ namaḥ śivāya || nama prathamo muktimūrttiśivaḥ || oṃ namo namaḥ
śivāya namaḥ || dvitīyo mūrttiśivaḥ || oṃ namo namaḥ || tṛtīyo
vadguru puspa tu deyo yorājyai rūpapaścimaiḥ ||
oṃ aghorebhyo namaḥ || maṇḍalamadhye || oṃ aghorebhyo namaḥ || prācyāṃ ||
oṃ ghoraghoratarebhyaśca namaḥ || yāmyāṃ || oṃ sarvataḥ sarvasarvebhyo
namaḥ || vāruṇyāṃ || oṃ namaste rūparūpebhyo namaḥ || udīcyāṃ || iti
tribhiḥ padaistu devasya taddhi tatpuruṣasya tu ||
